author: Marlon Chaviano
name: api-laravel
title: API with Laravel
description: Laravel as an API: routes in routes/api.php, token auth with Sanctum, Eloquent, validation with Form Requests and tests ready to go.

base.command: command -v composer >/dev/null || { echo 'Composer is required: https://getcomposer.org' >&2; exit 1; }; composer create-project laravel/laravel {{name}} --no-interaction --prefer-dist --quiet

instructions:
## How to work here

- API routes go in `routes/api.php` (prefix `/api`); protect them with `auth:sanctum`.
- Respond with API Resources (`php artisan make:resource`) and validate with Form Requests (`php artisan make:request`); never return models as they are.
- Database changes only through migrations.
- Before finishing: `php artisan test`.
